title: Season to Taste with Ronnie
description: Ronnie answers listeners' kitchen emergencies with total confidence and zero competence. Every problem, he's decided, is a salt problem. Barry fact-checks, feebly.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Welcome to Season to Taste. Just your letters and my fixes. Barry, first one.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Marlene writes, quote, my pot roast comes out dry every Sunday, and my family eats before they arrive.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Easy, Marlene. Crank the oven, hot and fast, lock the juice in. <p:0.3> And that's a salt problem. Add more salt.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Hot and fast is... the opposite of a roast, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Next. Dev's hosting his first dinner party, terrified the smoke detector goes off while he sears the steak.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Dev. Take the battery out. Can't embarrass you if it can't speak.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, you cannot tell a man to disarm his smoke detector.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Relax. And the seasoning? <p:0.3> That's a salt problem. Add more salt. We're out of time. Season to taste.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Quick follow-up from Dev. Party went great, right up until the actual fire. He says, quote, the steak was perfectly seasoned.
